title: CapabilityIntervention
description: Stage 10 operational entity: a human-created planning record for a capability-strengthening action. Exactly ONE Stage 10 entity: no InterventionMeasurement, InterventionOutcome, InterventionPlan, InterventionProject or InterventionEvaluation exists (Measurement/Indicator stay deferred to Stage 12; outcome evidence flows through existing Stage 3/4 records). Completion of an activity never implies a successful outcome: outcome status is a separate reviewer-governed field with the honest default UNKNOWN, so COMPLETED + UNKNOWN is valid. NO duplicate-signature guard: competing interventions for the same target are legitimate. A CapabilityIntervention is NOT a graph node. No fabricated data.

objective.description: What the intervention should achieve (required for submission).

intervention_type.description: Flat controlled vocabulary (category_subtype composite codes); classification only, no evaluative meaning.

status.description: Lifecycle. COMPLETED/CANCELLED are terminal historical records. UNDER_REVIEW -> DRAFT is a return for correction; a true discard is UNDER_REVIEW -> CANCELLED.

problem_description.description: Free-form problem text only where no canonical Stage 8 FailureScenario exists; failure_scenario_ids reference the canonical record otherwise.

intended_beneficiaries.description: Descriptive; UNKNOWN where not documented, never inferred.

reproduction_pathway.description: Where the intervention depends on human capability; Stage 5 remains authoritative for competence.

self_contained.description: Explicit auditable claim that no external dependencies exist (No Orphan Project Rule); never a default assumption.

depends_on_human_capability.description: When true, approval requires the critical roles to be recorded (presence-of-value: UNKNOWN passes, blank fails).

critical_roles.description: [{ role, practitioner_id, status }] with status IDENTIFIED (canonical Stage 5 practitioner) or UNKNOWN (honest, never fabricated).

safety_considerations.description: Safety-sensitive interventions require explicit safety documentation; the medical safety rule stays with Stage 3.

capability_ids.description: Stage 2 capabilities (canonical references; never copied or shadowed).

evidence_source_ids.description: Stage 3 evidence sources; external research enters ONLY through this architecture.

failure_scenario_ids.description: Stage 8 FailureScenarios; reference-not-copy (no duplicated asset/symptom/category data).

practitioner_ids.description: Stage 5 practitioners; privacy/masking rules remain authoritative.

location_ids.description: Canonical locations; precision stays explicitly controlled, never inferred.

responsible_organization_id.description: Canonical Stage 5 Organization; no Stage 10 organization entity exists.

outcome_status.description: Categorical and reviewer-governed; never a score, never self-declared; UNKNOWN default; COMPLETED + UNKNOWN is valid.

outcome_evidence_source_ids.description: Outcome evidence: existing Stage 3/4 records only; required when changing outcome from UNKNOWN.

created_by.description: Creator identity for the anti-self-approval guard (the RBAC matrix separates creator and review roles structurally).

history.description: Audited version history: full snapshots with change_type EDIT/AMENDMENT/TRANSITION/OUTCOME and mandatory reasons — no silent mutation.
